native_reference.acceptance: Controller pairs actual native shell and Flea captures before accepting any UI mirror unit. Source extraction alone does not certify native fidelity.

adaptation: Shell-source entries describe observed source behavior. Flea-adaptation entries map that behavior to file-manager geometry. Shared-text-contract entries preserve approved Flea bidi, date, key and content rules; they are not claims of corresponding shell widgets.

panels.rule: Mirror overlay and card contents and descendants. Keep the popup or keyboard panel at its configured bar anchor; mirroring contents does not move its outer window.

rail.rule: Place the application rail at logical leading (right in RTL), including its row mark, cursor edge and pointer targets. This maps mirrored panel contents to Flea; it does not relocate the configured desktop bar or dock.

columns.rule: Reflect visual column and cell geometry in its container. Preserve model indices and path identities; map input through the inverse rather than reversing the listing or row data.

menu_arrows.rule: The submenu affordance points left in RTL and right in LTR. Place it at logical trailing. Do not reflect unrelated glyphs.

navigation.rule: Physical Left advances and Right goes back in RTL; h/l follow only where their navigation bindings are active. Vertical moves, Tab/Shift+Tab, Return, Escape and text editing keep their semantics. Menu Backspace goes back only with an empty filter after edit handling.

path_crumbs.rule: Reverse only the directional crumb separator and its logical placement. Keep ancestor/path identity order and every path component unchanged. Shell dmenu detail strings are explicitly exempt from separator replacement.

sliders.rule: Minimum is at logical leading (right in RTL), maximum at logical trailing. Mirror fill, knob, ticks and pointer-to-value together. Numeric values and vertical wheel increment meaning stay unchanged.

toggles.rule: Unchecked knob is at logical leading, checked at logical trailing, so checked is left in RTL. Keep checked state and the click target unchanged.

alignment.rule: Swap logical left/right alignment and anchors with layout direction; preserve centered and vertical alignment. SizedImage changes placement inside its box, never its image pixels.

numbers.rule: Keep locale-formatted numeric text and its unit in LTR run order, isolated from surrounding RTL labels. Do not reverse digits or change Locale formatting.

dates.rule: Keep the core fixed sortable date form and isolate the whole date/time run LTR. Mirrored column placement does not reverse date characters.

keycaps.rule: Keep the resolved key label and canonical chord order unchanged, isolating the display run LTR. Mirrored navigation changes an action mapping, never keycap bytes or shortcut identity.

nondirectional_icons.rule: Keep nondirectional artwork, file-kind marks and vertical sort arrows unchanged. Only a glyph with a navigation meaning can reflect; moving its box does not reflect its pixels.

media.rule: Transport controls remain previous, play, next with their original glyphs in every language. A surrounding panel can mirror independently.

file_content.rule: Do not reflect file or preview pixels, document contents, QR modules or filename/path bytes. Strip raw bidi and single-line display controls before isolating names and paths with automatic run direction; preserve original backend path bytes and mirror only surrounding application chrome.

dock.rule: The dock app strip and its drag/drop slots keep physical order and configured position. Its window inherits RTL for menus while the strip explicitly disables inherited mirroring.

weather.rule: A numeric weather reading and its unit keep their order inside a mirrored panel.

qr.rule: QR module columns retain left-to-right order so the code scans; surrounding panel layout can mirror.
